svg.text: Separate copper, solder mask and paste; actual native polygons shown at enlarged scales.
U1 power-land paste: 75.08–75.52% of mask openings. Small differences include rounded corners and polygon conversion.
U1 origin is package-centered. U5 uses TI DBV0005A lands; its C26 bypass is physically separated.
Supplier review remains required for the 0.125 mm stencil example, mask registration, cap planarity and X-ray criteria.
